import asyncio
from asyncio import TaskGroup


async def per_item(users, save, notify):
    for user in users:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as group:
            group.create_task(save(user))
            group.create_task(notify(user))


async def per_batch(groups, read):
    for batch in groups:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        async with TaskGroup() as group:
            for item in batch:
                group.create_task(read(item))


async def map_with_concurrency(items, width, operation):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as group:
            for item in items[offset : offset + width]:
                group.create_task(operation(item))


class WrongBody:
    async def map_with_concurrency(self, items, width, operation):
        for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            async with TaskGroup() as group:
                for item in items[offset : offset + width]:
                    group.create_task(operation(item))
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            await audit()
